conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 38 years old and male. I came in because my back started hurting after I was raking leaves yesterday, and I've been having some pins and needles in my right foot ever since. It's been bothering me a lot, and my partner is here because they've noticed it hurts more when I stand up.
